pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE BATTLES OF BADR AND UHUD

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.1: The Battles of Badr and Uhud

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Battles of Badr and Uhud. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in The Battles of Badr and Uhud
2. Practise The Battles of Badr and Uhud at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Battles of Badr and Uhud

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in The Battles of Badr and Uhud
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in The Battles of Badr and Uhud. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise The Battles of Badr and Uhud at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise The Battles of Badr and Uhud at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Battles of Badr and Uhud
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to The Battles of Badr and Uhud. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Battles of Badr and Uhud using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Battles of Badr and Uhud in the examples.
2. Explain The Battles of Badr and Uhud to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Battles of Badr and Uhud.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Battles of Badr and Uhud using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Battles of Badr and Uhud important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in The Battles of Badr and Uhud
2. Practise The Battles of Badr and Uhud at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Battles of Badr and Uhud

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
